descripcion: NEW STREET, 2. El tendero. Dos muertes confirmadas de la misma familia.
_guion: Texto del Guion jugable del Acto I.

abre.texto: If you are collecting money, Reverend, it is a bad time.

opciones.texto: I have come about the deaths.

el_negocio.texto: Bad. People are afraid to go out. They say the air in the street is what kills them.

opciones.texto: I have come about the deaths.

las_dos.texto: Two people upstairs. My wife's mother, Hannah Peel, died on Thursday. She was eighty-one. Our maid, Eliza Hart, died on Saturday. She was sixteen.

el_agua.texto: The girl went to the Broad Street pump for water. The Marshall Street pump is nearer, but my wife's mother said it tasted of the drains.

_pivote: Dos muertes con nombre, edad y día; la ficha pide emparejarlas.
